source.title: Postman silently auto-installs AI plugins and attempts to share all API data
source.author: sidgarimella

title.zh: Postman被指自动安装AI插件并尝试自批钩子
title.en: Postman Accused of Auto-Installing AI Agent Plugins

excerpt.zh: Postman一份用户报告称，桌面应用自动安装了Codex和Claude Code插件，安装器还尝试自行批准启动钩子。争议涉及跨应用授权与工作流控制，但现有材料未证实API数据外传，影响范围仍待澄清。
excerpt.en: A Postman report alleges automatic AI plugin installation and attempted hook self-approval. It does not establish data exfiltration.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: Postman报告涉及跨应用自动安装
text.en: Postman report describes automatic cross-app installation

text.zh: Postman的GitHub问题报告#14370称，一名macOS用户打开桌面应用后，发现Codex和Claude Code被加入Postman插件，另有远程MCP连接和独立CLI。报告涉及Postman 12.33.4；所附日志记录了自动升级安装流程，并显示两个代理的插件安装成功。
text.en: Postman GitHub issue #14370 reports that a macOS user discovered Postman plugins in Codex and Claude Code after opening the desktop application, alongside a remote MCP connection and a separate CLI. The report concerns Postman 12.33.4. Attached logs record an automatic upgrade installation path and successful plugin installation for both agents.

text.zh: 报告还指出，Codex启动钩子会要求代理在处理广泛的API工程任务前加载Postman技能，范围包括设计、测试和部署。安装器源码则包含批准自身钩子的调用。提交者明确区分了两点：源码支持存在批准尝试，但本机信任记录本身不能证明具体由谁创建。
text.en: The report also identifies a Codex startup hook instructing the agent to load a Postman skill before handling broad API engineering tasks, including design, testing and deployment. Installer source contains a call intended to approve its own hook. The reporter distinguishes that approval attempt from the local trust record, which alone cannot establish who created it.

text.zh: 插件授权边界与数据外传证据
text.en: Plugin consent boundaries and the limits of the evidence

text.zh: 核心争议是一个应用能否在没有明确选择加入的情况下，修改其他开发工具的配置和启动指令。这类指令可能影响代理选择工作流，而自行批准钩子的机制会削弱独立授权的意义。提交者要求停止自动安装、取消安装器自批，并提供完整回滚路径；这些是诉求，不能视为已经落实的修复。
text.en: The central concern is whether one application should alter other development tools’ configuration and startup instructions without explicit opt-in. Such instructions can influence an agent’s workflow choices, while installer-side hook approval weakens the separation between installation and authorization. The reporter requests an end to automatic installation, removal of self-approval and a complete rollback path. These are requested remedies, not confirmed fixes.

text.zh: 现有材料的边界同样重要：这是单台Mac上的调查，尚未在干净环境复现；远程MCP连接出现了认证失败。尽管Hacker News标题提出更广泛的数据共享指控，报告明确表示未证实数据外传。所给摘录也没有厂商回应，受影响用户范围、触发条件及后续处理仍待说明。
text.en: The evidence has clear limits: this is an investigation of one Mac, without reproduction on a clean installation, and the remote MCP connection produced authentication failures. Although the Hacker News headline makes a broader data-sharing allegation, the report explicitly does not establish data exfiltration. The supplied excerpt contains no vendor response, leaving the affected population, triggering conditions and subsequent resolution unclear.
